card.line: The Dung Gate was a gate in Jerusalem's wall, in the south-west part of the city. It was rebuilt under Nehemiah and later marked a point on a thanksgiving march.

moments.title: Nehemiah inspects the walls
moments.text: Nehemiah went out at night and looked over the broken walls and burned gates of Jerusalem. His trip took him toward the Dung Gate.

moments.title: The gate is rebuilt
moments.text: Malchijah, ruler of the district of Beth-haccherem, rebuilt the Dung Gate. He put in its doors, bolts, and bars.

moments.title: Thanksgiving choir marches
moments.text: Nehemiah set up two great thanksgiving choirs on the wall. One choir went along the top of the wall toward the Dung Gate.
